From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Embedflow + streaming: technical fit and next actions (Medicore)

Thanks for the time today — good conversation and I wanted to capture what we heard and propose concrete next steps so everyone is aligned. I pulled this together with input from Marissa and Karthik.

Summary of pain / goals you shared
- Triage latency on clinical search currently at ~1.2s median, spikes to 2.8s. Primary user impact is slower clinician workflows.
- Retrieval quality: misses on specialty terms and negations; you want embedding-based reranking on top of vector search to improve precision for top-5 results.
- Need structured summaries to populate discrete EHR fields (diagnosis codes, med list) — structured JSON output required with a strict schema.
- Compliance: HIPAA requirement, KMS integration, SOC 2 evidence, and US data residency.
- Cost sensitivity: expect >100k queries/month in POC-to-prod ramp; looking for predictable unit economics.

Recommended POC approach (high level)
1) Pilot scope: Embeddings + rerank on retrieval pipeline + small streaming generation path for clinician-facing summaries (2–4 token streaming for mid/long outputs).
2) SDK changes: provide a streaming+function-calling example that enforces your JSON schema via Redwood structured-output hooks. We'll include a small wrapper that validates and retries on schema drift.
3) Performance levers: configure prefix/KV caching for common prompt prefixes, continuous batching tuned for your seq-length distribution, and quantized model variant to reduce per-token cost during peak.
4) Deployment mode: recommend Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) in a customer VPC for the POC to satisfy compliance and latency; if you prefer hosted + VPC peering, we can provide a transient option for faster start.
5) SLAs & targets for POC: median response <200ms for short/interactive calls, 95th <450ms for streaming-generated summaries; rerank precision uplift target +12% top-5.

Attachments included: medicore-poc-scope.xlsx (high-level milestones), redwood-demo-code-sample.zip (prototype SDK snippets).

Asks / next steps
- Samir / Elena: share a small set (10–20) of PII-free example queries + expected JSON outputs so we can build schema checks.
- Procurement: confirmed pathway for an initial 3-month reserved capacity commit or NDA if required.
- Technical kickoff: propose Tue, Dec 7 for a 60-minute deep dive (Karthik to lead streaming/funcall walkthrough).

I'll coordinate scheduling and drop a proposed POC checklist. Thanks again — Ben

Thanks, Ben — very thorough, appreciate the write-up. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Priority: reducing triage latency is _job 1_. If embedding-based rerank gives the quality lift you described, that alone will help adoption.
2) Compliance: HIPAA + our internal KMS. Can you confirm whether Dedicated in a customer VPC meets both our SOC 2 and KMS requirements? If a Hosted-VPC hybrid is faster to start, what's the trade-off?
3) Streaming: do we need changes on our side beyond the SDK snippet? Specifically, will streaming require changes to frontend consumption for incremental tokens?
4) Pricing: can you provide a rough POC cost estimate range for 100k queries / month with the quantized model?

We'll pull a 15–20 item example set (anonymized) and share by Friday. We're interested in the Dec 7 kickoff; Elena will coordinate invite availability.

Samir
